I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message to confirm the new date. The signed order form for Tamsin Cold Chain is now due 26 July, replacing the 14 December date she posted this morning.

I also pointed out that 26 July 2026 has already passed. If Finance means July 2027, or the date is a typo, it's worth checking with them. She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. A signing deadline is an account fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat in the channel.
